inputs.national_total_rule: The prepared national total is accepted only after exact comparison to the pinned native Census SEX=0, AGE=999 row in nc-est2025-agesex-res.csv; source ID census-pep-national-single-age-v2025; SHA-256 6436d4f6972d415caf14cb20776807bc031fc9f1bfc9d6ff26055d592a2b0230. National age_13_plus and under_18 values are independently recomputed from the native national single-age rows and compared exactly.

inputs.source_adjustment: EIA source annual average retail price; state records only.

inputs.formula: A00100 thousand USD * 1000 / matching same-geography 2023 PEP total population
inputs.national_per_resident: Observed only after the 2023 national PEP denominator matches the pinned native Census SEX=0, AGE=999 row; A00100 thousand USD converted to USD before dividing.

inputs.source_release: per-row source release retained; state and publisher-national rows cite distinct USCS source releases
inputs.denominator: Census PEP total 2023; same geography/year only
inputs.national_rate: Observed only after the 2023 total PEP denominator matches the pinned native Census SEX=0, AGE=999 row; prepared native USCS numerator is retained as 1,941,540.

inputs.national_status: missing; source file contains state rows only.

inputs.source_release: NCHS NVSS Mortality 2018-2024, CDC WONDER release 2026
